As of December 31, 2016, we were a party to interest rate swap agreements which hedge variability in cash
flows related the U.S. LIBOR and SGD-SOR based tranches of the unsecured term loan. Under these swaps, we
pay variable-rate amounts in exchange for fixed-rate payments over the life of the agreements without exchange
of the underlying principal amounts. See Item 7A “Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures about Market Risk.”
